metadata.title: Isospectral congruence manifolds, spectral rigidity, and a converse to Vignéras
metadata.abstract: Let $B$ be a quaternion division algebra over a number field $k$ that gives rise to arithmetic Fuchsian or Kleinian groups, and let $\mathcal{O}$ be a maximal order of $B$. We show that every closed orientable Riemannian manifold isospectral to a principal congruence hyperbolic surface $X_\mathcal{O}(\mathfrak{a})$ is isometric to $X_{\mathcal{O}'}(\mathfrak{a})$ for some maximal order $\mathcal{O}'$ of $B$, provided that no prime factor of $\mathfrak{a}$ ramifies in $B$ and that $\mathfrak{a}$ satisfies a mild condition at the primes over $2$. This is a converse to the construction of Vignéras, which produces isospectral manifolds from maximal orders of different types. In particular the spectral genus of $X_\mathcal{O}(\mathfrak{a})$ has at most $t(B)$ elements, and $X_\mathcal{O}(\mathfrak{a})$ is spectrally rigid when the type number $t(B)$ is one. In dimension three we prove the same statements for manifolds that, in addition, have the same complex lengths of closed geodesics. The proof rests on a local result that characterizes, by traces alone, the subgroups of $\mathrm{SL}(2)$ over a $p$-adic ring that are conjugate into a principal congruence subgroup by traces. As applications, every principal congruence Hurwitz surface is spectrally rigid, among them Klein's quartic, the Fricke-Macbeath surface and the surfaces of the first Hurwitz triplet, which partially answers a question of Reid.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 算术双曲流形的等谱分类
analysis.workSummary: 对数域上四元数除代数 B 的极大序 O 所给主同余双曲曲面，若理想 a 的素因子不在 B 分歧且在2上方满足附加条件，则任何与其等谱的闭定向 Riemann 流形都等距于同一 B 的某个极大序 O′ 所给同层曲面。谱属至多为类型数 t(B)，t(B)=1 时谱刚性；三维结论另需闭测地线复长度相同。
techniques: p-adic SL(2) 子群的迹刻画
Vignéras 等谱构造的逆向限制
analysis.breakthrough: 把等谱歧义限制在有限极大序类型中，并推出主同余 Hurwitz 曲面的谱刚性，包括若干经典高对称曲面。
analysis.limitations: 理想的非分歧及2进条件不可省略；三维不能仅由 Laplace 等谱得出相同结论，还需复长度数据。至多 t(B) 不等于必有 t(B) 个等谱例。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
